meta.institution_note: KJ GPT treats KJSCE / KJSSE / KJSIT as the same K J Somaiya engineering college. `institution` is held as KJSIT for consistency with the rest of the graph; the name actually printed on each PDF is kept in `institution_name_in_source`.
meta.extraction_method: Every PDF downloaded and read. 14 had a text layer read with pypdf; 2 (the 2026-27 AEC and the SY Sem IV / DSY Sem III revision) are image-only scans whose pages were read visually.

empty_sections.finding: The official endpoint returns the literal body 'No Data Found.' - the section publishes no documents at all. Recorded as an observed fact; no content invented.

meta.policy_note: These are calendars and schedules. None of them states an examination rule, ordinance or penalty, so none is turned into a PolicyProvision. Examination policy already exists in the graph and is left untouched.
